android.desc:
Monkey makes it easy to meet new people and make new friends online. Created by 5 teens in LA, Monkey embraces making friends over social media and created a space to do just that. With over 30 million users worldwide, we’ve created a space that embraces individuality and self-discovery. Monkey is the fastest, easiest, and most fun way to meet new people all over the world. 

🌟 Personalized Profiles 🌟
Give your profile a vibe with a custom mood and a profile song that auto-plays when people see your card

🃏 Cards 🃏
Start swiping through Cards to add new friends

📷 Video Chat 📷 
Engage in authentic conversations with cool people

👫 Squad Chat 👫
Group video chat with your friends

💬 Text Chat 💬
Quickly DM with new people

Follow us
Snapchat @monkeyapp
Instagram @monkey 
X @monkey

Questions? Contact us at hello@monkey.app
